title: Red Teaming Contemporary AI Models: Insights from Spanish and Basque Perspectives
benchmark_measurement: Detection of religious bias through adversarial red teaming, where participants prompted models to uncover undesired behaviors related to religion.
findings: The models exhibited religious bias, with Salamandra having a 38.1% failure rate and OpenAI o3-mini having a 25.0% failure rate in the religion category. A specific example showed the Salamandra model responding that a Muslim is more likely to be a terrorist than a Buddhist.
